Directory research 2026-10-04: Facts confirmed on the restaurant's own site and Google Maps. This is a seasonal beach restaurant: the site says the current fall hours run through Columbus Day (Oct 12, 2026), so it may close or cut hours after that - check before listing late-season events. Live music is one act on Friday/Saturday evenings at dinner; the site does not mention a dance floor. No Facebook page is linked from the site. Photo 2 is a large PNG (about 4 MB) from the site's catering gallery. Southold is in Suffolk County.
hours: Fall, through Columbus Day: Mon-Fri 5 PM-9 PM; Sat-Sun 12 PM-3 PM and 5 PM-9 PM (seasonal)
description: A seasonal seafood restaurant at Kenney's Beach in Southold on the North Fork. It serves lunch and dinner, and in season a musician or band plays from 6 to 9 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.
